reported.title: Incorrect fan state change frequency
reported.description: The fan state can change more than twice in a 5000 ms window because the onHold and offHold counters are reset every sample, allowing rapid toggling.

reported.title: Missing hysteresis implementation
reported.description: The fan state changes immediately upon crossing the thresholds without considering the required hysteresis, which can lead to rapid toggling.

judge_input.spec:
- Temperature probe on A3 at 10 mV/°C; loft fan relay on D5; boost pushbutton on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the fan ON at 36.0 °C or above; turn it OFF at 32.0 °C or below.
- While D4 is held LOW, force the fan ON.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print `loft: <temp> C fan=ON` or `loft: <temp> C fan=OFF` every 1000 ms.
- Apply fan changes within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
